name: Agility Capital Holding Inc.
summary: Agility Capital Holding Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops, owns, and operates real estate properties in Peru and Nicaragua. The company operates casinos and slot parlors. It is also involved in the hospitality operation and office business; and rents office spaces and parking units. The company was formerly known as Agility Real Estate Inc. and changed its name to Agility Capital Holding Inc. in February 2025. Agility Capital Holding Inc. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Panama City, the Republic of Panama.
